name: Grow search and AI search visibility: keyword research, site audits, rankings and backlinks
summary: Grow search and AI search visibility: keyword research, site audits, rankings and backlinks. Four crons read Ahrefs for rankings, keyword research, broken backlinks and AI search share of voice, and save each as a report. The only write, deleting keywords the owner has retired, waits for a person to approve it.

covered_by.goal-setting: skill (seed keywords, target domain and the retire list live in settings)
covered_by.keyword-research: keywords cron (Ahrefs Keywords Explorer and the tracked list)
covered_by.site-audit: not yet (Ahrefs site-audit operations are mapped, no cron calls them)
covered_by.content-publish: not covered (neither platform puts page copy live; see gaps)
covered_by.google-business-profile: not covered (Semrush only, no adapter; see gaps)
covered_by.reviews: not covered (Semrush only, no adapter; see gaps)
covered_by.ai-search-visibility: ai-visibility cron (Ahrefs Brand Radar share of voice)
covered_by.traffic-review: rankings cron (Search Console keywords through Ahrefs)
covered_by.reporting: skill (reads the saved reports and writes the owner update)
covered_by.record-keeping: every cron saves a dated report in the store

crons.name: rankings
crons.summary: Daily: Rank Tracker positions and Search Console keywords for the target domain, saved as a dated report.

crons.name: keywords
crons.summary: Weekly: Keywords Explorer volumes for the seed keywords and the tracked list. Queues removal of any keyword the owner has retired.

crons.name: backlinks
crons.summary: Weekly: broken backlinks pointing at 404 pages, saved as a list to restore or redirect.

crons.name: ai-visibility
crons.summary: Weekly: Brand Radar share of voice across the chosen AI assistants.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. The crons save their results in the workflow store and call no write. The one live operation removes tracked keywords from Rank Tracker, and a cron can only queue it for approval.

ahrefs.covers: Rank Tracker, Search Console keywords, Keywords Explorer, tracked keywords, broken backlinks, Brand Radar share of voice

gaps: Google Ads is paid search, not organic visibility. It belongs to the ad-campaigns and ad-reporting workflows.

Semrush: its operations are mapped, but the kit holds no parameter names for its keyword and backlink endpoints, and the vendor pages in endpoint-map/raw/semrush are HTML without a spec. No adapter until those names can be confirmed.
Google Business Profile, reviews and local listings: no kit platform for Google Business Profile. Semrush's local operations cover posts, reviews and listings, but there is no adapter for them yet.
Site audit: Ahrefs site-audit.issues is mapped but no cron calls it yet. Content Helper topics (content-helper.topics) is mapped but not called.
Publishing page copy and blog posts: neither platform puts website copy live. A person does this in the business's website software.
Judgment steps stay with the agent skill: choosing target terms, writing pages and posts, deciding what to ask reviewers for, and reading the AI answers.
Brand Radar prompts and cited pages: the report and its prompts are set up in the Ahrefs app first. Cited pages are not read yet.

Docs-only until an Ahrefs account proves each read. Column names in the select parameters follow the response schema in endpoint-map/raw/ahrefs; confirm them in a live account before relying on the reports.
